newsitem.title: INDIA: India sugar prices steady as rains affect arrivals.
newsitem.headline: India sugar prices steady as rains affect arrivals.

text.p: Sugar prices were steady in a narrow price band on Friday, dealers said.
"Poor consumer demand and retail enquiries kept the market quiet," a dealer said. Sugar arrivals were affected by the heavy unseasonal rains in some producing centres, dealers said.
"Poor availability of trucks to carry sugar also hurt supplies," one broker said. "Truckers are demanding higher freight rates," he said.
Ready delivery sugar S-30 was quiet at 1,300/1,330 rupees per quintal while M-30 was steady at 1,325/1,370 rupees per quintal. Sugar mill delivery also held steady at 1,230/1,240 rupees per quintal.
